title: インテンシブイングリッシュ
subtitle: Intensive English
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: This program prepares participants to become engineers in a global society in the following ways: 1. Students are expected to improve their English communication skills by using English outside of the classroom. 2. By working with classmates from various cultural backgrounds, students will improve their ability to think globally, gain cooperation and leadership skills, and appreciate diversity. 3. Learn how to communicate even when there are linguistic or cultural barriers.
advice: This is a short-term study abroad program. Students will take English courses at KIT partner schools. Course contents will vary depending on the school. Detailed information will be provided during the application process / at the program orientation. During the program, students are expected to take the initiative to interact positively in English with those around them.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
